positions.title: Mechanical Engineer
positions.description:
Review relevant mechanical drawings for each project.
Write CNC programs required for each base.
Setup and operate CNC mill.
Perform quality inspection on all machined surfaces.

positions.title: Project Engineer
positions.description:
Create project specific Bill of Materials (BOM). 
Manage Bill of Materials (BOM), part numbers, and project hours in SAP. 
Review and approve all project drawings. 
Generate and review project specific process and instrumentation diagrams. 
Manage all technical documentation required for customer submittals. 
Assist production staff during the manufacturing process. 
Redline drawings to as-built conditions after production is complete. 
Review and approve all sub-vendor documentation. 
Complete inspections of all major components. 
Write CNC programs for all projects and assist production staff with mill operation. 
Mechanical lead for localization of steam turbine packages. 
Customer support during project installation and commissioning.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
Promote and reinforce MDS’ commitment to customer service excellence through developing and documenting product design
Interpret and understand customer specifications and engineering drawings
Manage and implement the company’s quality management system
Control disposition of nonconforming products from vendors
Assist in approval process of new materials and products
Manage purchasing and use of samples for customer and third party testing
Provide on-site IT support for the company

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin
The University of Texas at San Antonio

projects.title: Fire Science Final Project
projects.description:
Worked in a team of two, conducting experiments and collecting data to use in
validating the theories throughout the semester. Specifically studying the
flashpoint temperature and mass loss rate for liquid pool ignition of alcohols.

projects.title: Team Chevron - Senior Design Project
projects.description:
Team of four, sponsored by Chevron to study the effects of extended surfaces on
tubes experiencing natural convection. Personally handled all SolidWorks
modeling while sharing all other project duties evenly with team members.
